sourceDiscrepancies: Matching original question and official key booklets are retained in full. The separate blank Answer Booklet, Summary Answersheet copies and blank graph paper referred to in the questions are absent from the archive; the supplied completed Kepler/glass answer-sheet illustrations remain in the key. Native question pages7 and9 are blank. Question6 says photographs on the next page although its photos occur on native p10 after blank p9. Printed source errors/conventions are preserved and attributed locally: P2 negative dM followed by positive boxed dUm and changing absolute-work notation; P3 Qa=-W followed by positive released heat, dropped-mass wording and P0/V0 notation; P4 derivative/height signs, c/cs and time-delay description; P5 intermediate phiP versus final phiC, log log and r/logarithm numerical scales. The graph/grid pixels and printed fitted results are source data, not newly calculated measurements.

Native glass handwritten graph heading appears l-prime-squared versus h-prime-squared while printed equations/data/axes use h-prime-squared versus l-prime-squared; actual native pixels and all printed values retained.
